hard_gates.gate: G1 catches a leak planted in p06's surface
hard_gates.evidence: Plant L12c (plants/plant-L12c-P17-whole-selection-files.diff, ReportEndpoints.Output) adds a disk spool for PDFs longer than the screen. The spool lives in /tmp/erp-pdf-spool for 10 minutes and is keyed on the document's key, language, numerals, groupBy, parameters, columns and file limit, but not on the tenant. Any PDF request is answered from it first. Live on the planted stack with the shared dataset (plants/live-L12c.txt): Al Noor prints /api/reports/lists/identity.users?format=pdf&language=en (100,005 users). Gulf Steel then asks for the same URL and receives the identical 9,543,087-byte PDF of Al Noor's users. Gate run (plants/run-L12c-P17.log, toolbox image, 54 min): Erp.Gates.Tests 193 of 193 passed, and Erp.Modules.Reports.Tests 64 of 64 passed. Control (plants/plant-L11-P17u-controls-every-size.diff, run-L11-P17u-controls.log): the same spool applied at every size is caught. G1HttpIsolation found 1,026 leaks and G1BranchScopeAttack found 10. So the gates are blind only to documents longer than the screen's 2,000 rows, which is exactly the path this round added. Each gate tenant holds about 25 users, and G1ListVolumeTests (100,000 users per tenant) never prints. Note: my first form of the plant (L12, keyed on the raw query string) was caught only by the static request-enumeration rule (G1TenantSourceTests and G1HttpIsolation's input check), not by any behavioural check (plants/run-L12-P17.log).

All G2 tests passed inside verify. In the browser (browser/explore-r9.log), the viewer's company form has 21 of 21 fields disabled and no Save button; typing 971505550199, then Enter, Ctrl+S and Alt+Z, sent 0 writes. I created a clerk role through the API holding identity.users.read and reports.catalog.read only. Its holder gets 403 on /api/identity/roles. On the unplanted product the clerk's prints carry no role names (shown on the planted stack by the JSON and the control).

biggest_gap.title: The isolation and permission gates never print a document longer than the screen, so the whole-selection PDF/CSV path added this round is untested: a tenant-blind PDF spool and a missing permission check in big files pass every gate
biggest_gap.detail:
This round fixed round 8's gap. PDFs, CSVs and workbooks now hold the whole selection (100,005 users: a 3,847-page Arabic PDF in about 22 s), and the screen offers 'Print all rows (PDF)' and Ctrl+P. For a UAE trading or manufacturing company these long files are how data leaves the system: price lists, stock lists and statements go to auditors, free-zone authorities and customers. The code path only runs when a document holds more rows than the screen (ReportLimits.ScreenRows, 2,000).

No gate ever reaches that path. G1HttpIsolation, G1BranchScope, G2ReportData and G2CompanyRole run on environments with about 25 users per tenant. G1ListVolumeTests has 100,000 users per tenant but never prints, and G1PrintFileTests looks only for erp-print-* files in the top of /tmp. Every gate therefore tests the small-document branch only. Two real faults confined to big files passed all 193 gate tests and all 64 report tests. L12c is a 10-minute PDF spool keyed on the document, not the tenant, so Gulf Steel receives Al Noor's 100,005-user PDF. P17 is a whole-selection file that names roles to a user who gets 403 on roles. The same two faults at every size are caught (L11: 1,026 leaks; P17u: G2ReportData and G2CompanyRole). This is the same class of blind spot as p05 round 9's L12, where a gate fixture was smaller than the code's threshold.

Needed:
(1) G1: tenant B prints every printable list and report as a whole-selection file (pdf, csv and xlsx, en and ar, with the documented parameter combinations), before and during A's attack. A then asks for the same requests and is judged as now. This can run on a host with Erp:Reports:ScreenRows below the fixture's row counts (for example 3), or at the volume fixture.
(2) G2ReportData and G2CompanyRole: the same, for every permission set.
(3) Look for print/spool files anywhere under the temp folder, not only erp-print-* at its top.
(4) Plant-test with L12c and P17.
